findings.text: _MANIFEST_KEY_ON_LINE_RE treats any manifest-field word followed by a colon anywhere in an unquoted plain-text value as a second top-level key; the direct probe "tests: command output says status: complete" raises ManifestParseError, so a legitimate tests or evidence sentence can make a terminal manifest unreadable even though no second field was authored.
